title: Monero dissector extended - full breakdown of all data structures

not possible to reuse tvb_get_varint ? (or add a new type!)

Yeah I did research it and it is not possible to reuse, the Monero encoding is quite similar to `ENC_VARINT_QUIC` but has "bit ordering" reversed.

Regarding adding a new type, I can add if you think that's the best solution. Hard for me to tell if the Monero varint decoding will ever be useful for anything else. Please kindly tell me how you want it done (if to add a new type), I don't contribute regularly to wireshark so it's hard for me to feel the rules you guys try to stick to here.
